claim: Sampling strategies paired with specific aggregators improve failure prediction, especially on arithmetic datasets.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by evaluating failure prediction (AUROC) on arithmetic and non-arithmetic tasks with different sampling-aggregation combinations.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Sampling strategies paired for failure prediction performance

claim: APCVD synthesis of graphene yields monolayer films with better quality compared to LPCVD or PECVD under atmospheric conditions.

exclusions: limited to the reviewed studies on metal foil substrates

title: APCVD–monolayer graphene films principle
